script.body: How do you make lassi frothy without electricity? Just push down on this silver whisk.
script.voiceover: How do you make lassi frothy without electricity? Just push down on this silver whisk.
script.body_hi: बिजली के बिना लासी को फ्रॉथी कैसे बनाते हो? ज़रा नीचे धकेल दो इस सिल्वर विश्क से।

script.meaning: How do you make lassi frothy without electricity? Just push down on this silver whisk.
script.scenes: A close-up of the silver whisk with metal beaters, showing the long handle and push mechanism.; The hands push down on the whisk, demonstrating the rotary motion that creates the froth.

research.problem: The arm fatigue from whisking eggs or lassi manually with a spoon or fork
research.buyer_moment: Making a quick frothy lassi or coffee in the kitchen during a busy morning
research.surprise_detail: The simple push-down motion creates instant rotation
features: Multi-purpose for eggs, lassi, and coffee
research.people_reason: Adult hands are required to operate the push mechanism
